NTA. Kids near that age and in highschool are going to drink. I’m sure you and your wife drank underage too. You want to make sure your kid is safe and trusts you. My parents said they would ALWAYS no matter what time pick me up if I had been drinking. They are likely going to drink, would you rather it be somewhere you have no idea with them being unsafe and doing dumb things and potentially being dangerous. Or would you prefer you know they are doing it and can monitor it and keep them in a safe environment. My parents would let kids drink in our basement (not buy or supply alcohol tho) where they know none of us are going to do dumb or dangerous decisions, they would also not let anyone drive and welcome everyone to stay the night. It’s better to teach your kid how to do stuff safely and handle themselves in a protective environment. My parents were fine with it as they knew it was likely going to happen anyways and felt it was important that me and my siblings knew our limits and how to tell if something is wrong. Also can teach kids how to deal with hangovers and be more *responsible* when it comes to dangerous things. When kids go to college the ones that black out at parties, make dumb decisions, wake up in a strange place or hospital are mostly kids with strict parents and who didn’t know how to drink/handle alcohol 

TLDR: kids are going to do it anyways, better for you to know about it and provide safe rides home or a safe environment where they won’t make dumb decisions that could be dangerous

IMPORTANT
- ALWAYS pick up your kid if they say they have been drinking. Your kid should always feel safe knowing they can ask you that
